note: Full Molt (reversed) layer for the 14 Cups cards. Reuses the finished 'Elder of Cups' entry from reversals-sample.json verbatim and generates the other 13 to match. uprightMeaning aliases each card's existing coreMeaning; reversed + molt blocks are additive. Pips render via the procedural Molt filter; courts bespoke.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed
